minedSpec:
# PROPOSED rules, mined from the code (daedalus mine-rules; src/rule-mining). Not a reviewed spec: review before use.
# style: nestjs (ISE, confidence 0.86); layers: ISE preset-first
# mined rules: 18 (16 emitted)
# MR-001 [layer-direction, high 0.78] domain must not depend on infrastructure (7 edges infrastructure -> domain; 0/8 domain files import infrastructure)
# MR-002 [layer-direction, high 0.83] domain must not depend on application (14 edges application -> domain; 0/8 domain files import application)
# MR-003 [layer-direction, medium 0.71] domain must not depend on presentation (4 edges presentation -> domain; 0/8 domain files import presentation)
# MR-004 [layer-unobserved, low 0.36] infrastructure must not depend on application (no import between them either way) -- not emitted: style nestjs orders its layers totally: dependency-direction allows every inward import, and no-layer-skip applies to the layered style only
# MR-005 [layer-direction, medium 0.64] infrastructure must not depend on presentation (4 edges presentation -> infrastructure; 0/4 infrastructure files import presentation)
# MR-006 [layer-unobserved, low 0.36] application must not depend on infrastructure (no import between them either way) -- not emitted: style nestjs orders its layers totally: dependency-direction allows every inward import, and no-layer-skip applies to the layered style only
# MR-007 [layer-direction, high 0.81] application must not depend on presentation (11 edges presentation -> application; 0/8 application files import presentation)
# MR-008 [acyclic-files, high 0.97] no file lies on an import cycle (29/29 files do not)
# MR-009 [component-direction, low 0.42] folder component attendees must not depend on registrations (1 imports registrations -> attendees; 0/5 files import back)
# MR-010 [component-direction, low 0.43] folder component workshops must not depend on registrations (1 imports registrations -> workshops; 0/6 files import back)
# MR-011 [component-direction, low 0.33] folder component common must not depend on registrations (1 imports registrations -> common; 0/2 files import back)
# MR-012 [component-direction, high 0.76] folder component domain must not depend on attendees (6 imports attendees -> domain; 0/8 files import back)
# MR-013 [component-direction, high 0.79] folder component domain must not depend on workshops (8 imports workshops -> domain; 0/8 files import back)
# MR-014 [component-direction, low 0.44] folder component domain must not depend on common (1 imports common -> domain; 0/8 files import back)
# MR-015 [component-direction, high 0.81] folder component domain must not depend on registrations (10 imports registrations -> domain; 0/8 files import back)
# MR-016 [port-implementation, high 0.75] every *Repository class in infrastructure implements an interface declared in another layer (3/3)
# MR-017 [inject-abstractions, high 0.83] classes of application inject interfaces across layers, not concrete classes (5/5)
# MR-018 [core-package-free, high 0.89] domain (a core layer: it may depend on no other layer) imports none of @nestjs/common, @nestjs/core
# note: not mined as allowed but allowed by the nestjs order: application>infrastructure

spec_version: "1.0.0"

architecture:
  style: nestjs

  layers:
    # Layer order (inner → outer): domain → infrastructure → application → presentation
    #
    # NestJS dependency flow: Controller → Service → Repository → ORM/DB
    # This maps to: presentation → application → infrastructure → domain
    #
    # Unlike clean-architecture (where infrastructure is outer and depends on
    # application interfaces), NestJS treats infrastructure as an inner data-access
    # layer that application services call directly.

    - name: domain
      directories:
        - src/domain/**
      roles:
        - entity
        - value-object
        - domain-service
        - repository-interface

    - name: infrastructure
      directories:
        - src/common/filters/**
      file_patterns:
        - "**/*.repository.ts"
      roles:
        - repository-impl
        - orm-entity
        - external-service
        - middleware
        - worker

    - name: application
      directories: []
      file_patterns:
        - "**/*.service.ts"
        - "**/dto/**"
        - "**/*.dto.ts"
      roles:
        - use-case
        - dto
        - application-service
        - processor

    - name: presentation
      directories:
        - src/common/guards/**
      file_patterns:
        - "**/*.controller.ts"
        - "**/*.module.ts"
        - "**/*.guard.ts"
      roles:
        - controller
        - module
        - gateway
        - guard
        - interceptor
      decorators:
        - "@Controller"
        - "@Module"
